content:
omar: Rolling up a staggered A/B + canary for v3-quant-lite tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need agreement on auto-fallback rules and slice-weighted gating. Keeping this short: we saw a neat latency win but a small MRR regression concentrated in long-context docs. Can we standardize behavior?

leah: Outline please: what metrics, thresholds, and traffic shaping are you thinking?

omar: Quick numbers from perf smoke: 
```
baseline(v2p9): mrr=0.398, latency_p95=240ms, halluc_rate=0.009
candidate(v3-quant-lite): mrr=0.388 (-2.5%), latency_p95=190ms (-50ms), halluc_rate=0.012 (+0.3% abs)
long-doc-slice: mrr drop -6.2% (small sample ~2.1k requests)
```
My read: overall latency gains justify testing but long-doc slice is a concern. Proposal: run 10% A/B (stable) + 10% canary phased by slice-weight (long-doc gets max 5% initially). Gate semantics: use slice-weighted metric where any slice with relative drop >4% AND accounts for >=25% of total delta triggers a slice-hold (reduce candidate to 5% for that slice and run targeted warmup). Global rollback if global MRR relative drop >=3% OR hallucination abs increase >=0.6% OR three active windows failed.

ben: Minor: define window length. Also how do we compute "accounts for >=25% of total delta"? absolute contrib to error or weighted by traffic?

sophia: Window = 10m rolling, evaluate every 5m, require 2 consecutive failing windows before slice-hold and 3 for full rollback. For contribution, use delta_contrib = (slice_traffic_fraction) * (slice_relative_mrr_drop). Trigger if delta_contrib >= 0.25 * global_relative_drop. That avoids tiny slices tripping.

infra-bot: We can encode slice predicates into rollout-controller. Example config snippet: 
```
rollout:
  phases:
    - name: ab-stable
      traffic: 10
      by_slice_max: {"long-doc":5, "short":15}
      window: 10m
    - name: ramp
      traffic: 20
      window: 10m
  metrics:
    mrr:
      comparator: relative_decrease
      hard_threshold: 0.03
      soft_threshold: 0.01
      action_hard: rollback
      action_soft: reduce_traffic_to_5pct_for_slice
    hallucination_rate:
      comparator: absolute_increase
      hard_threshold: 0.006
      action_hard: rollback
  slice_rules:
    - name: slice_contrib_check
      formula: "delta_contrib = slice_frac * slice_rel_drop"
      trigger_fraction: 0.25
      action: slice_hold_and_targeted_warmup
  windows:
    eval_interval: 5m
    require_consecutive_hard: 3
    require_consecutive_soft: 2
```
CI lint will reject malformed formulas; will expand to real selectors on PR.

leah: I like the delta_contrib approach. A few asks: 1) add exclusion for single-turn cold sessions (<3 tokens) from MRR to reduce noise; 2) ensure sample weighting uses per-slice unbiased scoring (not raw counts); 3) capture kv_hit_rate and kv_warmup_time in slice telemetry.

omar: Agreed. Also proposing a short-lived shadow run (24h) on long-doc heavy traffic if slice_hold triggers, and a mandatory 10k long-doc offline eval with warmed KV before we consider global rollback.

ben: For automatic rollback cooldown, suggest 45m backoff before any auto-promote of same candidate. Prevents thrashing.

sophia: I'll add a small eval harness that runs the warmed long-doc examples and reports per-slice kv_hit and model outputs to concordance eval. We can gate global promote on concordance >= 0.98 for long-doc slice after warmup.

infra-bot: Created draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pull/2002 (contains rollout-config + slice predicates + exclusion filter).

omar: Ok team: action items: sophia adds warmed-eval harness + concordance gate; leah to update telemetry & unbiased weighting; ben to add backoff to rollout-controller; infra to convert config PR to actual rollout. If no blockers, schedule A/B+canary at 02:00 UTC.

leah: Fine with that. Ping me when infra PR is ready.

ben: ack.

sophia: will post initial warmed-eval results here ~40m after I start running.

omar: Thanks. Moving forward unless objections within the hour.
